APPLICATION PLANNING

Recommended Uses

28 oz silicone cup

Beach Parties ↗

A 28 oz silicone cup that flexes back: Stepped on in the sand and it flexes back; a rinse in seawater and it is back in use.

Camping & Outdoor ↗

Takes a knock on rock without cracking, and rinses in seconds.

Tailgate & Car Parties ↗

Dropped on asphalt and nothing breaks, so no shards to pick up after.

Confirm for your project

Check the venue's no-glass rule, wind and sand exposure, and how it gets washed；packed size, pack space and the temperature of hot drinks；venue container rules, pour size and how it travels in the car.

These are selection suggestions. Review the chosen configuration and sample against your intended use.
